title: The Bakery of Bellbird Bay
author: Astrid Crane
blurb: Zephyrine Vasquez, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
